reason: CI-runner throughput Tier B. Three changes, all gate-workflow files: audit.yml gains its first concurrency block (measured 0 cancelled of 164 PR runs over 14 days across 13 repos, versus 12/165 for lint-format on the same PRs in the same window, P(0 of 164) about 4e-6); lint-format.yml and typecheck-ts.yml lose their Gate Aggregator jobs (263 aggregator containers in an 842-run sample, each booting a full ephemeral container to run one case statement); secret-scan.yml makes gitleaks fetch-depth conditional, keeping full history on schedule and workflow_dispatch and using 50 on pull_request, matching the log-opts base..head range the next steps already compute. Aggregator deletion is safe because these gates are enforced by required_workflows on path plus ref, so no check name is watched, and audit.yml and secret-scan.yml already carry no aggregator at all under the same mechanism. pr-title.yml is deliberately excluded: its real job is conditional on pull_request so it is skipped on merge_group, and its aggregator converts that skip into a pass. Known residual: without an aggregator a cancelled real job yields a run whose conclusion is cancelled, and whether required_workflows treats that as non-passing is unverified; secret-scan.yml already has this exact shape today, so this extends an existing accepted configuration rather than creating a new risk class. Evidence relied on: green CI on the candidate commit (12 passing checks on PR 275), plus direct verification that lint-format's and typecheck-ts's real jobs carry no event condition and therefore run on both pull_request and merge_group.
